name: dumbbell bent over alternate rear delt fly
description: A bent-over fly performed one arm at a time to target the rear shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, a dumbbell in each hand hanging down.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso still and your neck neutral.
